challenge.title: Sum of Positive Numbers
challenge.description: Write an algorithm that calculates the sum of all positive integers in an array.

dataTypes.output: Number representing the sum of positive integers in the input

challenge.exampleSolution: SUM = 0 loop I from 0 to LENGTH of ARRAY - 1 if ARRAY[I] > 0 then SUM = SUM + ARRAY[I] end if end loop output SUM

challenge.title: String Reversal
challenge.description: Write an algorithm that reverses a given string.
challenge.exampleSolution: REVERSED = '' loop I from LENGTH of STRING - 1 to 0 step -1 REVERSED = REVERSED + STRING[I] end loop output REVERSED

challenge.title: Palindrome Checker
challenge.description: Determine whether a given string is a palindrome.
challenge.exampleSolution: IS_PALINDROME = TRUE loop I from 0 to LENGTH of STRING div 2 - 1 if STRING[I] != STRING[LENGTH of STRING - 1 - I] then IS_PALINDROME = FALSE end if end loop output IS_PALINDROME

challenge.title: Balanced Brackets
challenge.description: Check if a string of brackets is balanced using a stack.
challenge.exampleSolution: STACK = EMPTY IS_BALANCED = TRUE loop I from 0 to LENGTH of STRING - 1 if STRING[I] = '(' then STACK.push('(') else if STRING[I] = ')' then if STACK.isEmpty() then IS_BALANCED = FALSE else STACK.pop() end if end if end loop if not STACK.isEmpty() then IS_BALANCED = FALSE end if output IS_BALANCED

challenge.title: Queue Simulation
challenge.description: Simulate a sequence of enqueue and dequeue operations on a queue.
challenge.exampleSolution: QUEUE = EMPTY loop through OPERATIONS if OPERATION is enqueue(VALUE) then QUEUE.enqueue(VALUE) else if OPERATION is dequeue() then if not QUEUE.isEmpty() then QUEUE.dequeue() end if end if end loop output QUEUE
